messages:
raj: Heads-up: noticed a bump in token billing tied to WS reconnects. Looks like proxy's idle-ttl is dropping sessions sooner than our console considers them 'active' — seems like double-counting in the cost dashboard. Anyone else?

elaine: :eyes: which metric shows that? console 'session starts' or runtime 'active connections'?

raj: Console 'session_starts' is ~15% higher than runtime active-connections during the spike window. Proxy logs show `session_expire=idle_ttl` at 20s, but clients send keepalives ~25s when under load -> client reconnects. Runtime treats resume as new session for billing.

matt: If proxy tombstone TTL < client keepalive, we'll force reconnect storms. Why is idle_ttl 20s? Was that changed in the last rollout?

infra-bot: deploy-bot rolled ws-proxy v2.9.0 to canary 03/16 14:02 UTC (config `idle_ttl=20s`).

elaine: I think we accidentally decoupled 'billing session' from 'proxy session' lifetimes. Console/signals use resume token lifetime (1h) while proxy uses short tombstone. That mismatch explains the discrepancy.

console-pm: From UX: customers see big spikes in 'session starts' and assume their clients. Two options: (a) add a telemetry tag `reconnect_reason=proxy_idle` so SRE/console can filter, or (b) change billing aggregation to dedupe resumes inside token lifetime. Which is feasible?

matt: (b) touches billing pipeline and revenue rules — slow. (a) is quick: tag ingress events with `reconnect_cause=proxy_idle` and expose in dashboard. Also need to confirm proxy/gateway emits resume token header so the metering layer can dedupe later if we choose.

raj: Gateway injects `X-Resume-Token` on resume requests, but metering reads `connection_open` from proxy frontends which currently don't include that header. Short term: add `resume_token` to proxy access logs so billing/console sidecars can join on it.

sre-jen: We must avoid undercharging. Proposal: only dedupe if `resume_token` present and same `client_id` within a 2m grace window. Also add console metric 'deduped_by_resume' so Finance can audit.

elaine: Plan: (1) proxy adds `resume_token` to access logs (2) metering pipeline optionally fuses events by `resume_token` + client_id within `grace_window` (3) console shows new metric/flag. I can PR for (1) today. :thumbsup:

matt: I'll check billing/legal constraints — Finance may need to sign off on any dedupe that affects invoice lines. cc @finance-lead

raj: I'll open a short RFC with telemetry schema + sample log lines. Also proposing we raise proxy `idle_ttl` to 40s default to match common keepalive patterns and reduce jitter-triggered reconnects. Ping me if you want to pair on canary tests.

infra-bot: ticket created INFRA-1287: "ws-proxy: add resume_token to logs + increase idle_ttl to 40s in canary"
